integrity: The all-d statement is proved analytically from support closure and the Knill-Laflamme criterion. The included checker only corroborates support classification and arithmetic and is not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The correction is specific to the {2,2,d}, d>=5, D=5 example and to non-degeneracy for the full two-qubit correctable set. It does not assert existence or saturation of codes at the corrected upper bound and does not invalidate Theorem 21 as a sufficient statement under T^2<D.
title: Support-aware correction sharpens the \(\{2,2,d\}\) mixed-dimensional Hamming example
